reason: The OpenAI-compatible adapter lost chat turns to provider edge cases that mature harnesses absorb. A read timeout or torn connection was never retried, not in complete() (every routing step) and not before the first streamed token, so live ReadTimeout/SSLWantReadError failures ended turns as non-retryable errors; _send_with_retry now resends TimeoutException, RemoteProtocolError, ReadError and WriteError for model-inference operations and _stream_with_retry does so while no output has been read, under the existing RetryPolicy, and an exhausted attempt is a retryable ProviderOverloadedError (a stream is still never replayed after output). complete() crashed with raw TypeError/AttributeError/JSONDecodeError on "tool_calls": null, "function": null, choices [null] and non-JSON 200 bodies; those are now read safely or raised as ProviderResponseError. A 200 body carrying {"error": ...} was accepted as an empty answer and finish_reason error/content_filter as a complete one; the body error is now classified (transient codes retried through a new _send_with_retry inspector), finish_reason error raises a retryable error and content_filter a ProviderResponseError naming the filter, in both paths. String error codes (server_error, overloaded_error, ...) and OpenRouter's Provider returned error/disconnected wording were never transient, so a leading frame was not replayed; they now are when no numeric status is given. The stream kept reading past [DONE] and threw away a finished reply when the connection then stalled or tore; it now stops at [DONE] and completes with a warning diagnostic when the failure follows the finish reason. Context-overflow detection gained the xAI, llama.cpp, Kimi, Poolside and Anthropic 413 wordings, reads error.type, and is checked before the 5xx overload branch. SSE parsing skips non-JSON keepalive frames (diagnostic) but types a damaged JSON chunk, surfaces event: error text, splits LF-joined data lines, maps legacy function_call to a tool call, shows refusal as the reply text and accepts double-encoded argument objects. tests/v3/test_openai_compatible_robustness.py drives each shape (51 of its 56 tests fail on main; 5 are guards), test_transport_failures_become_provider_errors_with_a_reason was updated for the new retry contract (fails on main), and the selected existing provider tests exercise the retry helpers, error classification, SSE framing and response parsing that changed.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through src/nebula/v3/providers.py) does not exercise provider transport failures, error bodies or SSE framing; the Python tests drive them directly. Scoped per the CI-scoping rule: only the new file plus node ids of existing tests that directly exercise the changed functions; the whole test_providers.py, test_provider_contracts.py, test_openai_compatible_parameters.py, test_tool_suggestions.py and test_dsml.py files were run locally (238 passed). No full suites.
